title: mBER designs VHH binders with million-scale experimental screening
summary: Two libraries of over 1 million designed VHHs against 436 targets; screening 145 targets gave specific significant success against 45% of targets (over 100 million binding interactions). Preprint; abstract only; screening binding is not therapeutic function.
ai_technology: mBER built on ColabDesign with sequence and structure conditioning

source_review.scope: Abstract and metadata via Europe PMC; full text not read

evidence.tested: Two libraries of over 1 million designed VHHs against 436 targets; screening 145 targets gave specific significant success against 45% of targets (over 100 million binding interactions).
